title: Elastic Hysteresis
textbookText: The plastic region between the elastic limit (point B) and the fracture point (point E) determines the ductile nature of materials. A longer plastic region indicates greater ductility, while a shorter region signifies brittleness. Ductile materials, such as those used for bending wires, are preferred. Materials that do not follow Hooke’s law even within the elastic limit are called elastomers. Rubber is a prime example of this type. A Few Terms: The elasticity of a body refers to its tendency to regain its original configuration after the removal of a deforming force. While some bodies immediately regain their configuration, others may take some time. This delay in regaining the original configuration is called the elastic after-effect. For materials like quartz and phosphor bronze, the elastic after-effect is negligible, whereas for materials like glass fiber, it is significant. This difference explains why suspension coils in moving coil galvanometers are made of quartz and phosphor bronze. 1. Elastic after-effect for a perfectly elastic body is zero. 2. Elastic after-effect for a perfectly inelastic body is infinite.

Elastic Hysteresis When a material wire is stretched several times to its original length using a deforming force, the stress applied may not be proportional to the strain produced. However, the material regains its original configuration through a different path after the removal of the deforming force.
Hence, the phenomenon of following different paths of increasing and decreasing stress is called hysteresis. The loop formed in these two cases is known as the hysteresis loop.

Fig 8.17: Elastic Hysteresis A high amount of work is required to stretch the wire compared to contracting it, leading to the presence of a non-conservative force. The difference in the work done represents the energy loss, which is balanced by the area of the hysteresis loop. This phenomenon is the reason for using rubber as a vibration absorber, as rubber exhibits a large hysteresis loop.
